scope_guards.student_facing_message: The molecular structure of specific carbohydrate polymers is beyond AP Exam scope. Cellulose, starch, and glycogen can support understanding/examples without requiring exact structure reproduction.
scope_guards.allowed_use: Supporting diagram, optional enrichment, conceptual recognition.
scope_guards.prohibited_use: Do not make exact molecular drawing/reproduction a mandatory AP-memory-palace target.

scope_guards.student_facing_message: Exact molecular structures of amino acids are beyond AP Exam scope. Students still need the conceptual component groups of a generic amino acid.
scope_guards.allowed_use: Supporting diagram, optional enrichment, conceptual recognition.
scope_guards.prohibited_use: Do not make exact molecular drawing/reproduction a mandatory AP-memory-palace target.
